capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Hyundai Canada states “a battery capacity of 84.0 kWh” for the Preferred Long Range RWD without saying gross or usable; recorded as gross.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Battery voltage 697 V (Australian-market sheet; same pack).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: page lists the 84 kWh E-GMP pack (2025 IONIQ 5 Long Range/XRT) as SK On NCM 811 pouch; EV Database also says NMC for the 84 kWh IONIQ 5. Hyundai Canada only says lithium-ion.

charge_port.notes: NACS charge port; two CCS adapters (AC and DC) included.

published_10_80_min.notes: “Approximately 18 minutes” from 10% to 80% on a 350 kW charger (manufacturer claim).

ac_max_kw.notes: US page: home charging up to 10.9 kW. Hyundai Canada page does not state it. EV Database lists 11 kW for the European car.

curb_weight_kg.notes: Guide Auto lists 1,985 kg (4,376 lb) for the Canadian Preferred RWD (84.0 kWh); matches the US 2026 SE RWD (4,376 lb). Canadian spec relayed by a car guide, not read on Hyundai Canada.

wheels.notes: Hyundai Canada 2026 page lists 19 in Aero alloy wheels as an exclusive feature; legal note refers to the Preferred Long Range RWD. Per-trim table did not load.
